label: About
title: About Black Grid Incorporation Fold
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 1 and A New Beginning: Ford to Reopen Michigan Central Station after Multi-Year Historic Restoration, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Black Grid Incorporation Fold: Bright abstract civic registration field, diagrammatic fold composition, overhead scan plate grammar. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against oversized black ink slab on ruled grid, raised central restoration fold, and blank right paper field with dotted stamp islands.

typography.body_family: 'DFE Newsreader', Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
typography.rationale: Fraunces gives the title an organic, seed-label quality; Newsreader keeps the explanation calm and readable.
